atoms.name: Lightweight image compression service
atoms.capability: Fetch a remote image by URL and return a JPEG capped in resolution and file size, suitable as a pre-processing step before vision models.

input.url: publicly fetchable image URL (JSON body, form field, or query param)

contract.output: JPEG, longest side <= MAX_DIM (default 1600 px), <= MAX_BYTES (default 4 MB); pass-through if already small enough; ?json=true returns size stats instead

errors.400: missing url / fetch failed / compress failed (JSON with detail)

atoms.host: https://imgcompress-cc9w.onrender.com (Render free tier, spins down when idle)
consumers: Rabalux Product Description Flow (make.com scenario, in production since 2025)
